blocks.text:
To: Tiffany Munoz
Cc: David Chang

The reference set is up and the first searches are running, so we can fold your documents in the moment they arrive. I am handling the prior-art and freedom-to-operate searching behind David Chang's note.

One thing will speed the reading. When you send the document set for {{fact:f:E-2025-001.client}}, add a short note on which rights are central to the transaction, and we will search those first. Nothing you send needs to be clean; your working files are enough for us to start from, and we will note the version of anything still in draft.

Once we have that priority list, I can tell you within a few days whether the Price-Henson searches turn up anything that needs a closer look. If they do, it goes to the partner before it reaches you.
